summary.en: A page lying at a three-quarter angle comes apart: its parts rise along the page's normal one after another, hang while the camera turns a little, then drop back in reverse and land with one thud.
summary.zh: 页面 3/4 斜躺，构件沿法线错峰升起、悬停一拍让镜头小绕、再逆序砸回，一次阻尼落锤收口。

fits: How a product is built (layers, modules, the stack); an architecture told as one object.
notFor: Pages whose parts overlap or have no clear blocks; text that must be read while it hangs (it is at an angle).

intent.en: "See what it is made of": the viewer sees a product's layers lift apart and click back, the Apple-style exploded view of its build.
intent.zh: “看看它由什么组成”：观众看到产品的各层升起分开再合回，苹果发布会式的爆炸图讲清构成。

content.en: Wraps one page with 3–6 clearly separate blocks (their rects, non-overlapping), ideally cut from real screenshots part by part; optional callouts are the scene's.
content.zh: 包住一张页面，带 3–6 个互不重叠的独立构件（给出各自位置），最好按构件分别截图；标注说明归场景。

fits.zh: 讲产品怎么搭起来的（分层、模块、技术栈）；把架构当一个实体来讲。

notFor.zh: 构件互相重叠或分不出块的页面；悬停时要读的文字（是斜着的）。

en: Needs the page as separate parts; one flat screenshot cannot come apart.
A big camera move: with dives and other 3D showpieces, at most two per film.
zh: 页面要按构件拆开给；一整张截图炸不开。
大动作：和俯冲等 3D 炫技合计一支片最多两次。

upstream.name: 爆炸分层视图
upstream.summary: 整页 3D 倾斜后构件沿 Z 轴错峰炸开悬停，一拍后逆序合体震屏收口
upstream.use: 把平面页面当 3D 实体拍的高光段落；两式都是"大动作"，一支片合计 ≤2 次
